gaps.title: Missing UI display for Moodle role hierarchy mapping
gaps.jtbd: When configuring the Moodle integration, I want to see how Moodle roles are mapped into the archive's internal role model, so that I can verify and understand the role hierarchy mapping.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given the role mapping exists in the database, When an administrator views the role settings, Then they should see a visual display or API response showing the mapped hierarchy.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'отображение иерархии ролей' is requested but missing in the product output

gaps.title: Tokens passed in URL query parameters
gaps.jtbd: When authenticating via SSO, I want my session tokens delivered securely, so that they are not leaked in browser history or server logs.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a successful SSO login, When the system redirects back to the frontend, Then the access and refresh tokens must not be included in the URL query string (they should be set via secure cookies or passed in a JSON body to an interim endpoint).
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: Passing sensitive bearer tokens as query parameters in a redirect URL is a critical security vulnerability.
